LogtailConfig.description_en: The data structure of the Logtail configuration

configName.description_en:
The name of the Logtail configuration. The name must be unique in the project to which the Logtail configuration belongs. After the Logtail configuration is created, you cannot change the name of the Logtail configuration. The name must meet the following requirements:

The name can contain only lowercase letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
The name must start and end with a lowercase letter or a digit.
The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length
configName.description_zh:
Logtail配置的名称，在其所属Project内必须唯一。创建Logtail配置成功后，无法修改其名称。命名规则如下：
只能包括小写字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
必须以小写字母或者数字开头和结尾。
长度必须在2~128字符之间
configName.title: logtail 配置的名称。

createTime.description_en: The time at which the Logtail configuration was created. The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
createTime.description_zh: Logtail配置创建时间。UNIX时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
createTime.title: 创建时间，unix 时间戳。

inputDetail.description_en: The detailed settings of the data source. For more information, see [inputDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29058.html）
inputDetail.description_zh: 日志输入的相关配置。更多信息，请参见[inputDetail参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29058.html）
inputDetail.title: logtail 输入的详细配置。

inputType.description_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

plugin: Logs such as MySQL binary logs are collected by using Logtail plug-ins.
file: Logs from text files are collected by using existing modes, including the full regex mode and delimiter mode
inputType.description_zh:
日志输入的方式。可选值如下：
plugin：通过Logtail插件采集MySQL Binlog等日志。
file：通过固定模式（正则模式、分隔符模式等）采集文本文件中的日志
inputType.title: logtail 读取日志的输入类型。

lastModifyTime.description_en: The time at which the Logtail configuration was last modified. The value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of seconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
lastModifyTime.description_zh: Logtail配置最后一次更新时间。UNIX时间戳格式，表示从1970-1-1 00:00:00 UTC计算起的秒数
lastModifyTime.title: 最后一次修改时间，unix 时间戳。

logSample.title: 日志样例，可以用于自动生成正则捕获字段。

outputDetail.description_en: The detailed settings of the data destination. For more information, see [outputDetail]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29058.html）
outputDetail.description_zh: 日志输出的相关配置。更多信息，请参见[outputDetail参数说明]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29058.html）

endpoint.description_en: The endpoint. For more information, see [Endpoints]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29008.html）
endpoint.description_zh: 服务入口。更多信息，请参见[服务入口]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/29008.html）
endpoint.title: 日志项目的 endpoint。

logstoreName.title: 输出的目标 logstore 名称。

outputDetail.title: logtail 输出的详细配置。

outputType.description_en: The type of the data destination. Set the value to LogService. Collected logs can be uploaded to only Simple Log Service
outputType.description_zh: 日志输出的方式，只支持LogService，即只支持将数据上传到日志服务
outputType.title: logtail 输出的目标类型。这里固定选择 LogService。
